content: Consensus across multiple sources: for simple CRUD (create/update/delete a transaction or category) a Server Action + revalidatePath is sufficient and is the recommended default in Next.js App Router -- no client cache, no query keys, works without JS. TanStack Query is recommended only when you need client-side caching, background refetching, or real-time sync that outlives a single navigation; TanStack's own docs advise against calling Server Actions from a queryFn because Server Actions run serially from the client, conflicting with React Query's parallel fetch model. This project already has TanStack Query installed for other reads -- do not introduce it for these new mutations; keep them as Server Actions to match the existing auth feature pattern.
